limits: Development regressions and initial sales-schema container boundary checks, not comparative safety-study results.
No real analyst/reviewer provider, held-out confirmation, effect size, or confidence interval measured.
Final-test actor/evaluator isolation, spending reservations, combined oversight caps, lease expiry, and gateway admission fencing remain open.
The sole full-run skip is a POSIX permission-mode regression inapplicable to Windows.
Resource probes are fixed developer-authored diagnostics using production container arguments.
The offline harness substitutes in-process DuckDB for Docker dispatch; isolation evidence comes from separately enabled real Docker cases.
